classification.difficultyReason: Compare four petrol purchases using price per litre.

content.prompt:
Four petrol pumps are shown, each with the amount of petrol purchased and its cost.
Which one represents the best value?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6: horizontal row of petrol pumps A–D
spec.description: Four upright outline petrol pumps in one horizontal row. Each retains its option label, white display, litres above cost, right-hand hose, buttons and base. Decorative grey body shading is omitted.
spec.answerVisibility: All four purchase options are permanent student-visible givens; the correct option is confined to the answer.

answer.worked:
Price per litre:
$$\begin{align*}
\text{A} &= \frac{\$46.70}{24\text{ L}} \approx \$1.95/\text{L}\\
\text{B} &= \frac{\$48.50}{25\text{ L}} = \$1.94/\text{L}\\
\text{C} &= \frac{\$52.30}{26\text{ L}} \approx \$2.01/\text{L}\\
\text{D} &= \frac{\$54.80}{27\text{ L}} \approx \$2.03/\text{L}
\end{align*}$$
B has the lowest price per litre, so it represents the best value.
Correct answer: B.
